during training...

text_block_list.text:
"Haaah... Dammit...! My body just won't 
move the way I want it to...!"

text_block_list.text:
You're telling me you're wiped out already 
from just this? Talk about pathetic...!
choice_data_list: How about taking a short break?

text_block_list.text:

nowhere near done yet—

text_block_list.text:
Whoa-ooh?! I-I tripped?! What the heck's 
wrong with me...!

...She seems to be carrying a lot of 
fatigue. We might need to reconsider her 
race schedule.
